name: Food4Tritons
team: Shana Ibatuan, Sukirat Kaur, Angelina Jo, Pragya Gunturu
description: Food4Tritons is a multi-page web application designed to centralise food resources for the UC San Diego student community. The site is organised across four pages namely Home, Pantry, Clubs & Events, and Recipes. Each page serves a distinct purpose while maintaining a cohesive visual identity built around a pastel blue, yellow (Triton colours) and beige colour palette.

name: TritonEats
team: Sheila He, Fiona Feng, Jocelyn Chen, Miaofen Zhou, Peilin Zhang
description: TritonEats is a website designed to help students explore and navigate campus dining halls. UCSD has a large variety of dining halls across campus, but it can be difficult to know which location has the best meals, restaurants, or menu items. This website organizes UCSD dining halls by location, shows the restaurants inside each dining hall, and provides descriptions and images of each restaurant. Students can also rate restaurants based on taste, value, and overall experience. By collecting student ratings, TritonEats helps students make better dining choices and gives a clearer picture of which foods are most popular across the campus.

name: Triton2Where
team: Jake Xiang, Yang Ding, Qingyu Wu, Xuanru Li, Ziyan Jiao
description: Triton2Where is a website designed to help users discover places to eat and explore. It pull data from a Google Sheet and use a smart filtering system, allowing users to sort by keywords, price range, and custom tags (e.g., Vegan, Study). Key function include a real-time Open Now filter based on the user's local time, a live San Diego weather widget, a randomizer that give a random store, and a link to google form to continuously grow the database.

name: TritonPlus
team: Yubu Wang, Cait G, Evelyn Mares
description: In our website you are able to log in using your gmail account. Once there you can see your info, you can see your calendar. Our app was meant to allow you to create post however we found out that you had to pay so the feature does not work. Our app does not function as intended.

name: TritonStudy
team: Amanda Tsai, Berne Chu, Shiloh Hsieh, Shiyi Wang, Shuwen Wen
description: TritonStudy is a study group finder for students in UC San Diego, where users must find and participate in study groups in order to keep King Triton alive. Users can create study groups for specific classes, set how big they want to be, where they want to host it, etc. and also join study groups from the main page calendar feature. There is also a leaderboard, displaying the most studious tritons, to incentivize students to study more and get to the podium (although this feature isn't linked to the database yet so it's populated with placeholder hardcoded data...). This webapp implements an authentication system with google oauth, directing user to onboarding if it is their first time signing up. It also has a postgresql database for data storage, a proxy to ensure that users are signed in to access the actual webapp, and a functional study group system. Users can join study groups that still have space in them to partake in fun fun studious times, all while keeping our lovely school mascot King Triton alive and thriving.

name: UCSD Events Hub
team: Saina Attam, Hien Tran
description: UCSD Club Events Hub is a full stack web application that aggregates STEM club events from across UC San Diego into one searchable platform. Students can search events by keyword, filter by event type (workshops, panels, competitions, socials, seminars), view detailed club profiles with contact information and social links, and add events directly to Google Calendar in one click. Clubs can submit their own events and register new organizations through a built-in submission portal with an admin approval system. The backend is built with Python and FastAPI connected to a PostgreSQL database containing 7 UCSD STEM clubs and their events. The frontend is built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

name: Hamster Vision
team: Gloria Lee, Aryhanna Pham, Wenrui Zhang, Ailyn Becerra
description: Our website lets users express how they’re feeling and instantly receive a hamster meme that matches their emotion. It includes three different backgrounds, an informational pop-up card, a camera feature that showcases the user’s emotional character with camera permission logic, and sound effects that play along with the hamster meme!

name: Music Boxd
team: Sophia Gomez, Geer Ai, Yuting Duan, Emily Chang
description: Our website, MusicBoxd, is a music-centered platform designed for users to discover music, browse artists and playlists, and share opinions through ratings and reviews. The homepage introduces the site, which includes navigation to Home, Artists, Playlists, and Sign In. It also features highlighted artist images and a “Featured this Week” section that showcases selected songs and albums for users to explore.

name: InTune
team: Corrine Wu, Alva Huang, Emily Liu
description: Match users based on their music taste and listening preferences.

name: Pop Culture Tourism
team: Diana Zhu, Lauren Peabody, Sydnie Yee
description: Pop Culture Travel Guide is an interactive website designed for fans who want to visit real-world filming locations from their favorite movies and TV shows. The platform centralizes locations from popular franchises such as Harry Potter, Star Wars, and Twilight, allowing users to explore them through franchise pages and an interactive global map. By combining organized location information, map visualization, and user interaction features, the website helps turn fictional worlds into real travel destinations for pop culture enthusiasts.

name: Zodiac Pop
team: An Nghi Nguyen, Sarah Kim, Elysia Jin, Christina Asinobi, Callie Chen
description: The Zodiac-based Pop Culture Recommendation Calculator is an interactive web application that combines astrology with personalized entertainment discovery. Users input their birthday and select a preferred genre from an interactive dropdown, which the app uses to calculate their zodiac sign and generate four tailored pop culture recommendations — spanning movies, music, celebrities, or shows — that align with both their astrological profile and genre preferences. The app features a dynamic Zodiac Information Card Deck that displays personality traits and characteristics tied to the user's sign, a sidebar for easy navigation, and a Profile section for users to save their birth charts. Built with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

name: Matchstick
team: Kaitlyn Nguy, Kaley Chung, Jayani Duggirala, Tiffany Yu
description: Matchstick is a website that helps students study for their classes by matching them to study groups and providing them academic resources (i.e. study spaces and Pomodoro timers).

name: FindYourFood
team: Akshetha Vishnu Prasad Dhivya, Amy Tran
description: Allows user to input dining hall foods they have tried around campus and rate them.

name: AP Credit Explorer
team: Alexandra Cody, Renee Agatep, Emi Yee, Annika Gangrade, Minami Jones
description: This website is a tool for incoming UCSD students who want to know more about how their AP scores will translate to the different colleges' GE requirements. I thought this would be a helpful resource for streamlining the tedious information-gathering across the 8 colleges which have different ways of interpreting AP scores. The user selects the name of their AP courses and corresponding scores, then once they've completed their list they press Compare Across UCSD Colleges" to view a comprehensive output of each college and which requirements of theirs will be satisfied."

name: Divide the Day
team: Alyssa Gong, Pranati Gupta, Julina Liu, Anusha Sivadalla, Lindsay Tang
description: Our website is a K-Pop Demon Hunters themed math learning site targeting for younger elementary students.

name: Project Pet Smart
team: Nicole Fong, Hannah Pham
description: The educational website targets K-12 students, offering an interactive guide to responsible pet ownership. It utilizes interactive tools and comprehensive care instructions to prepare those interested in owning a pet the daily commitment of caring for a pet and promotes the value of shelter adoption.

name: Educational Interactive
team: Alisa Soloveva, Kalyssa Choy
description: Our idea of an educational website is an interactive map of the countries in the Americas. You can click on a country of interest to learn more facts about its geography and culture. You can also listen to the country's most popular song on Spotify and save it to your in-web playlist. After exploring all the countries, you can visit the quiz page and take a multiple-choice quiz about them.

name: Studify
team: Olivia Huard, Sydnie Yee, Rosalyn Cham, Sakura Nishikawa, and Elisa Le
description: Our website is a hub for study resources. Use the buttons on the home page to access study tools such as a flashcard maker, habit tracker, planner, grade calculator and class schedule tool.

name: Farmers Market
team: Hannah Tran, Varsha Jawadi, Alice Lan, Romy
description: Contains About the farmer's market, Directions, Featured food vendors, Event Schedule, Links, RSVP form, image gallery that you can click through to select images to zoom in. Unfortunately the nav bar and buttons don't lead anywhere

name: RSVPortal
team: Cailey Murad, Loreen Samaan, Khuyen Lai, and Kumiko Komori
description: RSVPortal is a web application that aims to be a centeralized platform for UCSD events! UCSD students can post and discover events, from club meetups to study sessions.

name: Moondance
team: Keyura Valalla, Sophie Mo
description: This is an event website showcasing a fictional film festival. It features a carousel with images of the movies that would be screened at the festival and a functional RSVP connected to Formspree.

name: Diamond Dash
team: Nela Schechtman
description: Diamond Dash is a 24-hour Minecraft mining challenge for UCSD students. Players compete to mine the most diamonds before the server closes. Key Features: live Minecraft survival server (24 hours), PvP with real-world rewards, top 3 players win exclusive prizes, and built-in player compass for tracking other players. In the website you can learn the rules, RSVP for the event, view the schedule, and view prizes.

name: Preserving San Diego
team: Stephanie Yan, Nikita Jos, Serina Wang, Simar Gowda, Sharon Ma, Tanya Sinha
description: A website that educates and encourages its visitors to participate in local efforts toward preserving the beauty and history of San Diego's natural ecosystems.

name: Light Polution
team: Akari Oh, Anagha Kamath, Gayathri Kuniyil, Himansi Gupta, Katherine Charry
description: This is an educational website aimed at raising awareness about light pollution, its causes, and its effects on both the environment and human health. It provides an interactive platform where users can learn about light pollution through visual aids, interactive elements, and detailed explanations.

name: Shop Local
team: Esha Shah, Cameryn Mogul, Shruti Senthilram
description: 'Shop Local, San Diego' is a website highlighting local businesses in San Diego, encouraging community support of small shops and restaurants. The site features a clean, eco-themed design with smooth animations and mobile responsiveness.

name: Sustainable Living
team: Kyla Ma, Perla Ramirez, Joy Liu, Sophia Hernandez
description: Our website is about sustainable living. We want to teach people about what we eat, what waste we produce, and how to reduce it. Explore our website to see where you stand and join our cause!

name: Triton Wayfinder
team: Hoang Dung Tran, Sydney Su, Khuyen Lai, Anna Pak
description: Our website is for UCSD students, visitors, and guests to help them navigate through and around campus
